rule_text: IF at 'A_Create Application' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'A_Submitted'
IF at 'A_Submitted' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Handle leads'
IF at 'W_Handle leads' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Complete application'
IF at 'W_Complete application' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Shortened completion '
IF at 'W_Shortened completion ' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'O_Create Offer'
IF at 'O_Create Offer' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'O_Created'
IF at 'O_Created' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'O_Sent (mail and online)'
IF at 'O_Sent (mail and online)' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Validate application'
IF at 'W_Validate application' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND normal volume THEN route to 'W_Validate application'
IF at 'O_Created' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND high volume THEN route to 'W_Call incomplete files'
IF at 'W_Call incomplete files' AND low delay AND low rework AND early in case AND high volume THEN route to 'W_Validate application'
